newsitem.title: USA: Kenneth Cole stake held by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Kenneth Cole stake held by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by Boston investor Jeffrey Vinik said Tuesday it holds a 4.98 percent stake in Kenneth Cole Productions Inc or 366,100 Class A common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said stake was purchased between January 23 and March 4 at prices ranging from $18.4949 to $22.5756 per share for investment purposes.
Kenneth Cole, based in New York, designs and sources a broad range of footwear, handbags and accessories under its Kenneth Cole and Unlisted brand names.
